summary: Mantra audio feature testing complete. Fixed critical bug: Om mantra audio_url was pointing to invalid Wikipedia path (7/77 instead of 3/31). All backend tests pass (8/8), frontend audio player UI verified working.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility enhancement needed

seed_data_creation: Fixed Om mantra audio_url in MongoDB from invalid /7/77/Om.ogg to correct /3/31/Om.ogg
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mantra audio feature fully tested. Om mantra has working audio from Wikipedia Commons (https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/31/Om.ogg). Other mantras use timer-based fallback. Audio player UI shows play/pause, volume slider, loop toggle, skip button, progress bar, and repetition counter.

om_audio_url_404.issue: Om mantra audio_url was pointing to invalid path https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/77/Om.ogg which returns 404
om_audio_url_404.root_cause: Incorrect Wikipedia Commons file hash path in seeded data
om_audio_url_404.fix: Updated MongoDB mantras collection to use correct URL: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/31/Om.ogg
om_audio_url_404.verification: Audio now plays correctly in browser, no more 'Could not load audio' error toast

mantras_library.audio_badge: Om mantra shows 'Audio' badge on card, others do not

audio_player_ui.location: Shown in mantra detail dialog for mantras with valid audio_url
audio_player_ui.play_pause: Play/Pause button toggles correctly, changes icon state
audio_player_ui.progress_bar: Shows current time and total duration
audio_player_ui.volume_slider: Working volume slider with mute button

timer_fallback.trigger: When audio_url is null or audio fails to load
timer_fallback.ui: Shows 'Chanting Timer' section with play/pause and reset buttons
timer_fallback.progress: Timer-based progress bar with repetition counter

api_endpoints_tested: GET /api/mantras - Returns mantras with audio_url field
POST /api/favorites - Favorites endpoint works for mantras
